_about: Bombardier CRJ100/200/440 Airport Planning Manual (CSP A-020, Revision 8), 00-02-01 Figure 2: page index 24, layers.py --mode image at scale 10, clip 150,222,485,490 (plan; the same scale as the side view). Pixels of that raster, line centres; the upper half (the aircraft's right side, the same as its left). The wing's leading edge is drawn as two parallel lines: the outer one is the edge. The wing stops at 10.27 m out, where the front view shows the winglet leaving it; beyond that the plan's curved edges are the winglet's own. The tail cone runs on under the tailplane and the fin's top fairing: bridged to its end. The stub pylon's leading edge is the short line between nacelle and fuselage; its trailing edge runs from the exhaust in to the fuselage.
